      <title>Expel: Managed SIEM Detection Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country />
      <state />
      <skills />
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<p class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2">Are you a detection engineer who wants to bring real depth of expertise into a new and growing function and use it to deliver security excellence to customers? Expel's professional services practice is just getting started, and we're looking for the technical expert who'll deliver the work that gets customers ready to thrive under our co-managed SIEM model. You'll bring hands-on skill to a team that's finding its stride, help it grow, and have a real runway to grow into a lead yourself.</p>
<p class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2"><span></span>Here's the work. Customers come to us with SIEMs that should be surfacing threats but are instead consuming their teams: ingestion costs climbing year over year, engineers buried in alert noise and broken pipelines, and detection blind spots leaving real gaps. You're the engineer who turns that around: authoring and tuning detection content that satisfies real security use cases, closing coverage gaps, migrating detection logic off legacy platforms, and helping optimize what customers ingest and pay for, so their SIEM becomes a force multiplier again, not a management burden.</p>
<p class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2"><span></span>And because this function evolves right alongside our customers and the market, the work won't stand still. Expect it to grow into deeper integrations, automated and AI-assisted tooling, and security strategies our customers need next.</p>
<h2>What Expel can do for you</h2>
<ul>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-2-0">Give you a ground-floor seat in a new professional services function, where your expertise directly shapes the quality of what we deliver to customers</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-2-0"><span></span>Provide real runway for professional development as the function grows</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-2-0"><span></span>Put you on complex, high-stakes detection and SIEM problems across a wide range of customer environments</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-2-0"><span></span>Let you work across leading SIEM platforms, including Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, and CrowdStrike NG SIEM, plus emerging AI-assisted tooling</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-2-0"><span></span>Give you visibility and partnership across the organization, including Sales, Detection Engineering, our SOC, and Customer Success</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-2-0"><span></span>Accelerate your career by letting you own meaningful outcomes end to end</li>
</ul>
<h2>What you can do for Expel</h2>
<ul>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-4-0">Deliver end-to-end professional services engagements, including detection strategy, MITRE ATT&amp;CK assessment, SIEM optimization and integrations, SOAR playbook development, and custom log parsing</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-4-0"><span></span>Develop and validate detection content that satisfies defined security use cases, at onboarding and as environments evolve, with strong coverage and clean fidelity</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-4-0"><span></span>Optimize SIEM performance and cost by tuning detections for fidelity, reducing alert noise, and improving ingestion efficiency</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-4-0"><span></span>Contribute to Expel's professional services proprietary detection library, continuously improving our detection strategy and capability</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-4-0"><span></span>Translate detection logic between SIEM platforms and write custom parsers for standard and non-standard log sources, using AI-assisted tools where they help and validating the outputs</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-4-0"><span></span>Partner with Detection Engineering and the SOC to hand off environments ready for ongoing co-managed operations, and work with SOC analysts to sharpen the fidelity and actionability of rules and alerts</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-4-0"><span></span>Track the evolving threat landscape and turn it into new detection development</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-4-0"><span></span>Help the function grow by contributing repeatable processes, templates, and tooling that raise the quality and consistency of what we deliver</li>
</ul>
<h2>What you should bring to Expel</h2>
<ul>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-1-0">Hands-on SIEM expertise across Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, and/or CrowdStrike NG SIEM, including architecture, data ingestion, and detection rule development</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-1-0"><span></span>3+ years with detection and response tooling, particularly SIEM, SOAR, and EDR</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-1-0"><span></span>3+ years writing, deploying, and tuning custom detections from research or investigative work against common datasets (Windows Event Logs, auditd, CloudTrail, and similar)</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-1-0"><span></span>SIEM migration experience translating detection logic between platforms and re-pointing log sources</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-1-0"><span></span>Working knowledge of attacker tactics and techniques and the MITRE ATT&amp;CK framework</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-1-0"><span></span>Solid fundamentals across Windows, macOS, and Linux, networking basics (TCP/IP, OSI), and working knowledge of cloud IAM models and platforms</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-1-0"><span></span>Basic proficiency with Python, Go, or similar, and comfort using Git/GitHub for version control of detection content, scripts, and templates</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-1-0"><span></span>Curiosity, strong ownership, and the appetite for growth</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-1-0"><span></span>A willingness to travel up to 20%</li>
</ul>
<h2>Bonus points for</h2>
<ul>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-3-0">One or more SIEM or vendor certifications (e.g., Splunk Core Certified Power User or Enterprise Security Certified Admin, Microsoft SC-200, CrowdStrike CCFA/CCFR)</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-3-0"><span></span>Experience authoring platform-agnostic detections with Sigma and converting rules across SIEM backends</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-3-0"><span></span>Familiarity with detection-as-code practices, including version-controlled rules, testing, and CI/CD for detection content</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-3-0"><span></span>Industry security certifications such as GIAC (e.g., GCDA, GCIA), Security+, or similar</li>
<li class="artifact-docx-preview_heading2 artifact-docx-preview-num-3-0"><span></span>A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Information Security</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Additional notes</strong></h2>
<p>This role is remote within the United States.</p>
<p>The base salary range for this role is between $111,900 USD and $162,300 USD + bonus eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $120,000 and $140,000 based on experience, skills, and market data.</p>
<p>We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You'll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.</p>
<p>We're only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.</p>
<p>We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.</p>
<p>We'll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.</p>
<p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$111,900</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$162,300 USD</span></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/expel-managed-siem-detection-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/expel-managed-siem-detection-engineer</a></p>
